people.name: Eliathah
people.line: Son of Heman, appointed as a musician in David's time

translations.web: for the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translations.bsb: the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
translations.kjv: The twentieth to Eliathah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
translations.asv: for the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
